mara:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual transparent in-game dialogue portrait PNG for Amber Bridge, a small European-fantasy mercenary adventure; NOT concept sheet, NOT mockup.
Create exactly one square 512x512 portrait. Mara, a 32-year-old female practical mercenary swordswoman. Sun-touched light skin, hazel eyes, chestnut-brown jaw-length short hair. Worn silver armor, brown leather shoulder strap, distinctive muted red scarf. Calm determined expression.
Style: meticulously hand-placed-looking pixel art with distinct clean square pixel clusters, cohesive warm adventure palette, HD2D portrait asset. Use a deliberately restricted 32-color aesthetic, approximately 128x128 logical pixel detailing enlarged crisply to 512x512. No painterly brushstrokes, no smooth vector contours, no anti-aliased blended outlines. Sophisticated readable facial anatomy, modest grounded European medieval costume.
Composition: chest-up single character, centered, face in subtle three-quarter view facing viewer's right, eyes looking slightly right. Head from y=48 to 290, shoulders occupy lower half, torso ends at y=490 with a deliberate stepped pixel silhouette. Complete head/hair/shoulder silhouette within canvas, 20px breathing room left and right; generous face size for dialogue. Warm gentle upper-left key light with cool muted shadow, no theatrical glow. Dark warm brown selective outlines, not harsh black.
Background: true transparent alpha outside character, absolutely no colored rectangle, checkerboard, frame, landscape, text, title, watermark, ornamental border, drop shadow, prop or second character. No massive armor, crowns or epic fantasy embellishment. Preserve a crisp transparent pixel silhouette. This is the first portrait in a six-character matched set; consistent bust framing and pixel cluster size are important.
